faqs.question: How do I copy an emoji?
faqs.answer: Click any emoji to copy it to your clipboard. You can then paste it anywhere — in messages, documents, social media, or code.

faqs.question: Can I search for emoji by name?
faqs.answer: Yes. Type any keyword in the search box to find matching emojis by name, category, or description.

faqs.question: Which emoji versions are supported?
faqs.answer: The picker supports all Unicode 15.0 emoji, which covers all modern emoji available on iOS, Android, Windows, and macOS.
